posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie is the best team in Busters Anonymous and I'm done waiting for the collapse that never comes.
posts.detail: 8-1 with a league-best 1269.1 points-for, and the African Bald Fraud bit has been dead for three straight editions now — mjwithgoldhoops just graduated from middle-tier afterthought to the team everyone else has to catch.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's resume is now a historical document, not a scouting report.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish built an entire dynasty reputation, but Put it in Ra sits 2-7 with a league-worst-adjacent 929.86 points-for — the gap between pedigree and performance has never been wider anywhere in this league.

posts.headline: Thicks' ring means nothing if Klint's Clipboard keeps winning ugly at 1026.8 points-for.
posts.detail: 7-2 is 7-2, but that production barely nudges the middle of the pack — a champion should be lapping this field, not sneaking past it, and the title defense is still coasting on reputation alone.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh has fully completed the irony arc of the decade.
posts.detail: 2-7 with a league-worst 934.22 points-for and a career 12th-place average finish — the untalented tenth isn't a joke anymore, it's a documented scouting report on this franchise.

posts.headline: Sasinci's title defense is officially flatlined and Big Head can't find the paddles.
posts.detail: 4-5 with only 1026.66 points-for, a career record now sagging to 13-15 — for a team carrying an actual championship, this is the quietest, saddest fall from grace in Busters Anonymous.
